Eli: Quick hallway shoutout — Rae and Jon swapped stickers with the new interns and helped them find the microwave (priority!). tiny kindness, big impact. :sparkles:
Rae: they were so nervous. ended up doing a 5-min office tour and pointed them to the 'quiet nook'. felt nice. :house_with_garden:
Jon: also found the secret supply of spare chargers. lifesavers. :battery:
Sana: Adding this to the kudos board and sending a $15 coffee card each. want a sticker pack?
Rae: yes please! the interns loved the 'first week' sticker sheet.
SwagBot: issued sticker pack to Rae and Jon. logged kudos (1) each. (automated)
Eli: tiny gestures like this make onboarding feel warm. thanks all.
Jon: also posted a quick note in #office-life with the microwave quirks so future folks don't burn popcorn. :popcorn:
Sana: weekly roundup blurb incoming. official high-five incoming later in the kitchen. :raised_hands:
